product_summary: A loan to extend or add living space to an existing apartment, floor, or row house such as additional rooms and floors. Available for both existing and new customers.

pricing.other_charges_notes: Stamp duty, CERSAI charges, mortgage guarantee, administrative charges up to Rs. 5000, non-compliance charges up to 2% p.a., conversion charges 0.50% or Rs. 3000 (whichever lower)

collateral_accepted: Security interest on property being financed
key_features: End-to-end digital process with loan approval in 4 steps
Customised repayment options tailored to requirements
Online loan account for convenient management
Available for existing and new customers
Interest rates identical to home loans
Tax benefits on principal and interest under Income Tax Act, 1961
Disbursal in installments based on construction progress
Up to 20-year tenure or till retirement age (whichever lower)
fees_table_raw: Processing Fee: Salaried/Self-employed Professional 0.50% or Rs. 4000 (whichever higher) + taxes; Self-employed Non-Professional 1.50% or Rs. 5000 (whichever higher) + taxes. Conversion Fees: 0.50% of outstanding principal or Rs. 3000 (whichever lower). Premature Closure: Fixed rate 2% + taxes; Variable rate NIL. Administrative: Up to Rs. 5000 + taxes. Stamp duty, CERSAI, mortgage guarantee at actuals.
